name: acts
description: Generic Acts kernel. The $acts feature gives a space, or a catalog-owned actor anchored in one, an internal schema-validated fail-closed emission primitive on that sequenced log. $projection binds one composer and one log to single-writer folds, bounded views, and incremental idempotent rebuild from recorded observations. Domain facts and concrete projections live in consuming catalogs.

features.description: Stateless feature carrying the internal act-emission primitive. Mounted on a $space composer, or on a catalog-owned anchored $actor composer such as $dispenser_block, its effective surface is <composer>:act. Emission requires a sequenced turn on the composer's bound log and an internal caller; payloads validate against event_schema; attached projections fold in the same turn, fail-closed.

classes.description: Base class for act projections (ACT4): non-public composer and log bindings, consumes + internal fold, rows + bounded view, and incremental rebuild. Projection configuration and state are perms-empty; only the bound composer may fold. Rebuild is composer-mediated, so it never grants the projection a self-fold capability. The projection lives in its log space's anchor cluster so fold writes share the turn's atomicity.

properties.name: source_space
properties.description: The sole composer authority allowed to fold this projection, both live and during source-mediated rebuild. Set when the projection is created.

properties.name: log_space
properties.description: The sole sequenced space whose recorded Acts this projection consumes. Equals source_space for a space composer and names the containing space for an anchored actor composer.
